cashBasis: Net cash, including refunds, for my share. Comparisons cover full calendar months.
cashWindow: 12 months including this month, plus 3 forecast months. This month includes remaining scheduled charges.
incomplete: Some exchange rates are unavailable. Original-currency losses are retained; the base total is incomplete.
sharingBasis: Receipts in this period and unpaid billing periods starting in this period; earlier arrears are excluded.
mrrBasis: Current billing subscriptions, my share, normalized to a monthly cost. Annual plans are spread across months; this is not this month’s cash charges.
debitBasis: Positive charges only; refunds are listed separately and do not reduce the breakdown or ranking.
movementBasis: Monthly costs in the base currency, my share, valued at the period-end exchange rate. Dates show the contributing events, or the reporting window when no event is recorded.
totalBasis: Actual spending on these subscriptions from the first charge to today, at my share and net of refunds. Lifetime and stopped subscriptions have no ongoing monthly cost, so the total is shown instead.

lifecycle.omitted: Top 12 by lifetime spending; {count} more subscriptions
lifecycle.cashWindow: 12 months through this month; cash paid through today, net of refunds.
